title: The Release Rebuild Stops Running the Whole Suite
description: The release branch bundle rebuild cost 219-272s per run: a full root build the dist does not need (~65s) and a pre-push suite in the bot's own push (~204s) that the release PR's CI runs again. Phase 1 proved the hooks-only build plus the dist rsync byte-identical, so the step now does the minimal set and pushes with --no-verify.
